safety_invariants.loopback_restriction: Base URL must resolve to a valid loopback HTTP address (127.0.0.1 or ::1); non-loopback addresses fail closed with AI_PROVIDER_CONFIGURATION_INVALID.
safety_invariants.proxy_bypass: trust_env=False is explicitly enforced on httpx clients to prevent leaking prompts to OS/environment proxy servers.
safety_invariants.byte_limits: Max prompt characters: 200,000; max schema bytes: 256,000; max request bytes: 512,000; max response bytes: 2,000,000; max timeout: 300 seconds.
safety_invariants.cancellation_support: Background watcher thread aborts connections upon cancellation_event trigger with zero prompt leaks.
